name: io.github.compbioutils/evs-cadsr-mcp
title: NCI EVS + caDSR
description: Read-only NCI Thesaurus (EVS) and caDSR lookups with release-pinned, cited answers

environmentVariables.name: ECM_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Tool set: evs-only (default, no credentials), cadsr-only, or unified

environmentVariables.name: ECM_CADSR_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: caDSR user for the LOV and CDE Match services (unified or cadsr-only profile)

environmentVariables.name: ECM_LICENSE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: EVS license key for license-gated map targets such as MedDRA
